subject.title: feat: ask_user — structured questions from the agent with web card, channel buttons, and text answers

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `question.*`, `operator.questions`, and `plugin-sdk/question-gateway-runtime` as durable provider-neutral core and Plugin SDK contracts now, rather than retaining question handling only in provider-specific integrations?
rationale: This choice determines long-term Gateway authorization, native-client generation, plugin compatibility, and ownership boundaries; the patch can implement either direction, but source review alone cannot establish the intended permanent public surface.

options.title: Sponsor the provider-neutral contract
options.body: Accept the Gateway and SDK surface, contingent on fixing or disproving the text multi-select behavior and adding current-head real behavior proof.

options.title: Keep questions provider-specific for now
options.body: Defer the new public Gateway and SDK surface and retain the already-merged Codex-specific path until a broader core contract is approved.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the provider-neutral contract
recommendation.body: Accept the Gateway and SDK surface, contingent on fixing or disproving the text multi-select behavior and adding current-head real behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the adjacent merged question/card slice and this proposed generalization, so they are the best available contact to route the intended contract decision.
